## Versatile partnership categories for your enterprise

### Solution partners

Neo4j Solution Partners include system integrators, strategic consultancies, managed service partners and value-added resellers. Neo4j Solution Partners provide services independently of or alongside Neo4j. It is our most versatile partnership category customized to your particular business, with revenue-sharing opportunities from referrals or reselling.

[Learn more](https://neo4j.com/partners/solution-partners/)

### OEM partners

Neo4j partners with industry-leading service providers to integrate graph technology products within their solutions. Neo4j Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Partners disrupt the market by embedding or integrating Neo4j graph technology into their own products and services for delivery as a combined product to their end customers.

[Learn more](https://neo4j.com/partners/oem-partners/)

### Technology partners

Neo4j Technology Partners are public cloud platform providers and independent software vendors (ISVs) that integrate their technology with Neo4j’s graph database to expand their businesses and enhance graph applications in enterprise accounts. Partners provide unique technology to power AI/ML workloads, streaming data, BI applications and more.

[Learn more](https://neo4j.com/partners/technology-partners/)
